zh.name: 代码托管
zh.description: 连接 GitHub、GitLab 与 Gitea / Forgejo 账户，集中查看 PR、Issue、讨论和文件差异。凭证保存在本机，需要支持代码托管能力的桌面 App。

en.name: Code hosts
en.description: Connect GitHub, GitLab and Gitea / Forgejo accounts to browse pull requests, issues, discussions and file changes. Credentials stay on this computer. Requires a desktop App with code-host support.
